correctness.rationale: The six Walsh coefficients are orthogonally decomposed into two parity-supported three-coordinate Rademacher sums. Exact local Taylor series (2) and (3) show negative definite square Hessian on 2<p<3 and the sign reversal of the complete-flat Hessian at the unique root 3^(p-1)=4p-5. Perturbations in the inactive block have negative order-r^2 loss versus order-r^p gain. Exact branch moments cross once by strictly convex exponential h(t), between 5/2 and 3. Reproduced exact 16-sign moments, 44 rational parity identities, and numeric root diagnostics. No global conclusion is claimed.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial six-coefficient quadratic Walsh space displays two genuinely different strict local maxima for a continuum of p and a separation between the symmetry-breaking local onset and moment-height reversal. The distinct thresholds are exact natural invariants of competing stationary branches and matter to global sharp-norm optimization; the conclusion is more structural than a finite enumeration or p=4 table computation.
